notes: One combined Sinc coordinate scheme, RAW_HZ numeric-path control vs CENTER_25K offset/25000Hz. Same native sample25MHz/kernel79/channel24/filter synthesis/clamp. Fixed25000 chosen before any new target access using source frequency units and 50Hz minimum-band scale; no parameter scan.

Actual9source models (LEGACY50 32+18,OLD_GATE_COS50/TIME_MS50 33+17) final11100 Sinc moments verified. Student kernels relativeL2<=2.40711699e-8; final-moment algebra terms below half float32ULP; stationary native EMA replay reproduces saved teacher kernels. This supports experiment, not causal bottleneck or improvement proof.

Physical expression CENTER: originHz+25000*coordinate; coordinate initialization0; native RAW weightdecay applies actualHz while centered coordinate weightdecay applies offsets. EMA arithmetic coordinates also change. This is not pure isolated LR scaling; report combined coordinate scheme.
